lede: The biggest decision of the week lands Monday at Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission, where the first phase of a full Land Use Code rewrite goes to a vote — the kind of foundational change that sets development rules for years to come. Closer to home, Telluride Town Council meets Monday evening with three public hearings on second reading, including a deed-restriction conversion that would remove the price cap on two affordable units at 215 East Colorado. The County Commissioners continue a public hearing Tuesday on adopting updated international building codes, and the Housing Authority takes up that same deed-restriction question plus other structural housing changes.
